title: Spec frontmatter (specs/**/*.md)
description: YAML frontmatter block of a plan node (phase | epic | feature | story). Validated by parsing the leading --- block of each spec markdown file.

implemented_in.description: Join edge (#60 slice 2) to the code realm: realm-qualified addresses (repo-relative path, optionally #symbol) of what implements this node. Never a brain node id — the code realm is never compiled into the brain.

owner.description: Stakeholder name (matches an app/stakeholders.json entry by name, #55). gen-brain.py's ownership_links linker resolves it to an `owns` edge; no match emits nothing.
